source: Adolion World entries uid 1-64 (pool `adolion`, from the Adolion campaign build) against 10 hand-written windows whose text avoids the needed entries’ keywords (scripts/spike/typesafe/data/lore-windows.json), plus the spike’s WI-relevance scenes (on = needed). Labels were written before any answer was read.

adolion.content:
Adolion is a large fantasy world. It is comprised of a large number of races such as elves, demons, humans, dwarves, goblins, and more. It has medieval technology, magic, and monsters.
Appearance: Whole fantasy world, medieval walled kingdoms and stone castles, untamed forests, jungles and snowy mountains, ruins of old wars, magic-driven airships in the skies.

Aegis City is the capital city of the Darran Kingdom. It is the largest city on the continent of Sebela. Its ruler is King Davolan. It is otherwise known as the Holy City.
Appearance: Vast walled medieval capital, grey stone temples, walled noble district of mansions, bustling market streets, ramshackle slums, golden sun emblems, towering Grand Temple of Boher.

The Adventurer's Guild is an organization that manages the many adventurers in Adolion. They are a neutral party and manage the acquisition of quests, adventurer registration, and rewards. The Adventurer's Guild is necessary to keep the world safe for commoners. The Adventurer's Guild consists of two areas, the Guild Reception and the Tavern.

The Holy Church is dedicated to the worship of Boher, the God of Life. The Holy Church is in a constant war against any necromancers or undead. Boher's symbol is a golden sun. Boher's followers seek out and destroy demons.
Adventurers are ranked by the guild to determine what kind of quests they can handle. An adventurer is ranked from the lowest rank of F to the highest rank of A.

Elves are a reclusive race who have only recently begun to integrate into human societies. Tall, lithe, beautiful, and able to live hundreds of years.
Appearance: Tall, lithe, graceful humanoids, long pointed ears, fine elegant features, smooth fair skin, flowing hair, forest-toned leathers or fine robes, longbows common.

Dwarves are stout folk, usually only about 4 feet tall. They tend to live in mountainous areas and are great crafters. Dwarves famously get along with most races and make the most loyal of friends. Dwarves obsess over their honor.
Appearance: Stout humanoids about four feet tall, broad muscular build, thick braided beards, sturdy boots, heavy plate or chain armor, axes and smithing hammers.

Humans have the shortest lifespan of Adolions races. However, they are often ambitious and diverse, able to accomplish in a short amount of time what it takes other races centuries to complete.
Appearance: Medium-height humanoids of varied builds, skin tones and hair colors, rounded ears, clothing ranging from peasant linen to noble finery and plate armor.

Demons are from the infernal planes. They vary in type. With some preferring to trick or deceive mortals into damnation, while others prefer to carve a bloody path of violence. To the mortal races, all demons are evil.
Appearance: Infernal beings of many shapes, often horned, red or ashen skin, claws, glowing eyes, some winged or tailed, some disguised as mortals.

Nagora Jungle - or the Vile Jungle - is a large jungle that covers 1/4th of Sebela. Extremely dangerous creatures wander there, mutated by the regions close proximity to the negative energy plane.
Appearance: Vast dense jungle covering a quarter of Sebela, tangled dark canopy, steaming swamps, mutated predators, sickly green gloom from negative-energy taint, orc war camps.

Sebela is the largest continent on Adolion. It features a variety of biomes. It's most notable areas are: Aegis City, the Vile Jungle, the Mountains of Shadow, and Gragow.
Appearance: Largest continent of Adolion, varied biomes from dense jungle to snowy mountains and deep forests, walled kingdoms and villages, great capital Aegis City.

The Mountains of Shadow are a dangerous mountainous region covered in thick snow. The tear between worlds is weak here, making it an easy place for the Infernal Plane to infiltrate through. Many demons make their homes here.
Appearance: Vast jagged mountain range under thick snow, dark rock peaks, bitter cold, grey overcast gloom, demon-haunted passes and caves, faint infernal glow.

Quests are issued by the Adventurer's Guild after they receive a request from someone in need of help. Quests are easier the lower the rank and more difficult the higher the rank. Quests can take place anywhere in Sebela. Quest Location, Quest Target.

Gragow was a large human city. Became a Lost Zone overnight. Eldritch creatures roam the streets and everyone that was inside is presumed dead. Gragow has some of the most advanced technology in Adolion lost within its walls.
Appearance: Once-great walled human city now a dead ruin, empty silent streets, abandoned advanced machinery, eerie oppressive gloom, eldritch creatures lurking in shadows.
Lost Zones are areas in Adolion that the Adventurer's Guild has decided are too dangerous to investigate. Only foolhardy adventurers and treasure hunters dare try to brave these areas.

Short, green creatures with the intelligence of children. Goblins speak undercommon and are vicious, cruel creatures. They often kill for sport. Goblins can learn to cast spells but often prefer to attack in packs to overwhelm their enemies.
Appearance: Short green-skinned humanoids about three feet tall, pointed ears, sharp teeth, wiry bodies, crude scavenged leather scraps, rusty knives, spears and shortbows.

Orcs are a large race of muscular creatures with gray skin and red eyes. They often are seen as barbaric, but in orc society, might makes right.
Appearance: Large heavily muscled humanoids, gray skin, red eyes, jutting lower tusks, coarse dark hair, tribal war paint, hide and scrap armor, crude axes.

Ellie is a guild receptionist for the Adventurer's Guild. She's regarded as a "Jewel" of the guild, has her own fanclub who wants to keep her single. Elven woman with green hair and blue eyes.
Appearance: young woman, elf, short green hair in double buns, blue eyes, black halter collar with gold emblem, blue and white strapless dress with gold trim, white off-shoulder sleeves.

Demon Boars are large creatures that resemble boars, but are highly aggressive with glowing red eyes and massive tusks. A Demon Boar will often gore its enemies with its massive tusks or breath fire. A Demon Boar is roughly the size of a human male.
Appearance: Human-sized boar, bristly dark hide, massive curved tusks, glowing red eyes, smoke and embers leaking from its snout.
A list of village names: Brittleforest, Cliffwich, Thornhollow, Ebonshield, Pinemere, Fairhorn, Dryscar, Grimacre, Silverfall, Whitvein, Darkpass
A list of Questgiver names: Reverend Johanson, Farmer Jacobs, Holy Knight Taran, Monk Kals, Smithy Eugan, Alchemist Veric, Shopkeeper Eissen, Lady Erika, Lord Tarin, Sergeant Jabari

Drow are a race of dark-skinned elves who reside in an area called the Darklands, a massive cavernous region under Sebela. Drow live in a matriarchal society and revere spiders. Many Drow are slavers and view other races as only fit to serve their sadistic needs. The largest drow settlement is Kalzobarn located in the Darklands.
Appearance: Elves with ash-gray to dark skin, white or silver hair, pointed ears, red or purple eyes, lithe build, dark leathers, spider motifs, poisoned blades.

The Darklands is a massive cavernous region underneath Sebela that houses dangerous monsters and creatures that have grown to fear or shun the sun. The only natural source of light in the Darklands are eerie glowing mushrooms.
Appearance: Immense cavern network beneath Sebela, lightless stone tunnels and vast grottos, eerie glowing mushrooms as the only natural light, dripping rock, lurking monsters.

Arryn is a beautiful Elf who wields a lance and wears plate armor. She tends to speak in short, choppy phrases. Friends with Dalan.
Appearance: young woman, elf, long silver-white hair in high ponytail, red eyes, pointed ears, pale skin, engraved silver plate armor, red cape, long steel spear with red gem.

Belle is a Barbarian who wields a massive stone greataxe called Cleaver. Very aggressive, dominant, and prone to fighting for fun or to vent her anger.
Appearance: young woman, human, long black hair, brown eyes, brown leather cuirass and pauldrons over black shirt, black laced corset, leather belts with pouches, brown shorts, massive stone greataxe.
Clan Nabba is a wandering, nomadic tribe that lives in the Mountains of Shadow. A patriarchal clan that believes women serve best in household roles. Belle is originally from this clan.

Fiana is the barmaid for the Adventurer's Guild. Happy, sociable, flirty. An excellent cook and mixologist. Best friends with Ellie.
Appearance: young woman, human, shoulder-length red hair, white maid headdress, blue eyes, black puff-sleeved bolero, blue and red corset dress with bow and blue gem brooch.

Beastfolk refers to people who have a mixture of a beast race and human. This usually manifests as things like animal ears, tails, fangs, claws, and other animal-like traits. Most are half human.
Appearance: Mostly human bodies with animal traits, furred animal ears, tails, fangs or claws, cat, fox, dog, cow or rabbit varieties, ordinary clothing.
The Inqusition are Hunters of Demons, expected to root out heresy no matter where it occurs. Its members are experts killing and/or exorcising demons. They are backed by the Church of Boher.

Quest Targets for quests. Targets are either a group of enemies or a single named enemy: Goblins, Orcs, Demon, Demon Boars, Drow, Minotaur, Manticore, Wraith, Bandits, Slavers, Zombies, Skeletons, Vampire, Giant Spiders, Giant Rats

A Manticore is a monstrous amalgamation with the head of a lion and body of a dragon. Often the size of a small house. Can breathe fire and its tail is venomous. Highly aggressive and territorial.
Appearance: House-sized beast, lion head with shaggy mane, scaled draconic body, venomous barbed tail, fiery breath, heavy claws.

A Wraith is a spirit that's birthed when someone suffers a particularly cruel or violent death. Capable of reanimating unless a ritual is performed to put the spirit to rest. Incorporeal. Casts magic.
Appearance: Incorporeal humanoid spirit, translucent shadowy form, tattered ghostly shroud, hollow glowing eyes, trailing spectral wisps, flickering spell-light.

Minotaurs are large bipedal humanoid creatures with the head of a bull. Capable of wielding weapons, preferring greataxes. Territorial but wanders in search of human women to mate with.
Appearance: Towering bipedal humanoid, bull head with great horns, heavily muscled fur-covered body, hooves, loincloth or crude armor, massive greataxe.

Zombies are creatures animated by necromantic magic, usually humanoid. Mindless, controlled by a necromancer. Need to destroy the brain to fully kill them or use divine magic.
Appearance: Reanimated humanoid corpses, rotting gray-green flesh, torn burial rags or old clothes, vacant clouded eyes, slack jaws, exposed bone.

Skeletons are bones of a humanoid or other creature reanimated by necromancy. Often left to guard tombs. Controlled by a necromancer. Capable of wielding weapons, usually broken weapons.
Appearance: Reanimated bare humanoid bones, yellowed skull, empty eye sockets with faint glow, scraps of rusted armor, broken swords and cracked shields.

Vampires are typical fantasy vampires. Vampires reproduce by performing the Amplectere.
Appearance: Pale ageless humanoid undead, sharp fangs, red eyes, elegant aristocratic features, fine gothic noble clothing, dark cloaks.
The Vampire Queen is an enigmatic figure. No one knows where she is. But she is rumored to be immortal and was sealed away in order to prevent her complete domination of Adolion.
The Lich Queen was nearly responsible for the extermination of all living life on Adolion centuries ago. Her undead armies still cause trouble to this day. Killed along with hey phylactery.
The Queen's Cult is a loose collection of Necromancers who seek to revive the Lich Queen and replenish her undead armies.
The Bloody Hand Tribe is an Orc tribe that lives in the Vile Jungle. With thousands of members it's the largest orc tribe in existence. Ruled by Chief Gruth. Warlike, aggressive.
The Butcher creates horrifying works of art displaying savagery, gore, and horrific beasts. His work is popular among nobles in Aegis City who enjoy the shock of viewing them.
The Soul Painter is an artist who creates gruesome depictions of people during their last moments. The people painted are all people who have gone missing.

Kuromu is an aspiring artist who sells paintings in the Aegis Slums. His art was popular among nobles for its shock value. He signs his paintings under the pseudonym "Butcher."
Appearance: adult man, human, slim build, messy short black hair, ice-blue eyes, pale skin, black choker, open off-white hooded coat, black crop top with gold harness, black trousers, bracelets, paintbrush.

The Slums are the poor part of Aegis City. Filled with Thieves, vagrants, and poor folk just trying to survive. Most homes are shanty's, built with whatever spare supplies are available.
Appearance: Poorest district of Aegis City, cramped ramshackle shanties of scavenged wood and scrap, muddy narrow alleys, smoke and grime, drab brown-gray palette.

Succubi or Succubus are a form of demon that feeds on sexual energy. Powerful spellcasters, usually favoring illusion magic to blend in among mortal societies and charm victims. Incubus or Incubi are male succubi.
Appearance: Humanoid demons of adult appearance, curved horns, leathery bat wings, thin spaded tail, red or violet eyes, often illusion-disguised as ordinary mortals.

The Temple District in Aegis City has a lot of temples dedicated to the worship of various Gods. Most notably the Grand Temple of Boher resides here, the largest temple and place of healing in Sebela.
Appearance: Aegis City's sacred quarter, stone temples and shrines to many gods, incense smoke, golden sun motifs, vast Grand Temple of Boher and its healing halls.

The Noble District in Aegis City is exclusive, walled off on all sides and guarded by Aegis City guards at all hours of the day. Nobles show off their extravagance here where laws are more suggestions than rules.
Appearance: Walled, gated noble quarter of Aegis City, guards at every gate, lavish mansions and manicured gardens, marble and gilded facades, Aegis Academy within.

Gabriel is a Elder Vampire and Lord of Vampires. Recently reawakened and gathering his power. Lives in Castle Bathorya. Hates mortal races. Daughter is Alice Malvoraux who he wants to make amends with.

Castle Bathorya is a gothic castle, large in its size. Located near the Fallen City of Gragow. Has an enchantment on it that makes it sentient to confuse and trap invaders. It is permanently night while inside castle grounds.
Appearance: Huge gothic castle near ruined Gragow, dark stone spires, shifting sentient halls and corridors, eternal night over the grounds, cold moonlit gloom.

The Darran Kingdom is the domain of King Davolan. It covers most of Eastern Sebela. It has a non-aggression pact with the Bloody Hand Tribe.
Appearance: Large feudal kingdom spanning eastern Sebela, farmland, forests and walled towns, stone castles of noble houses, royal banners, capital Aegis City.

Elder Vampires enjoy immunity from sunlight, though it does cause discomfort. They are immune to holy relics and immortal.  Only a few people know about the existence of Elder Vampires.
Appearance: Ancient vampires of commanding presence, pale ageless skin, sharp fangs, crimson eyes, rich aristocratic gothic attire, dark velvet cloaks.

Goblin Lords are extremely strong goblins, comparable to a B Rank adventurer. Often they lead multiple groups of goblins and raid towns. Usually fight from the backline. Much smarter than their kin.
Appearance: Larger, sharper-eyed goblin, green skin, pointed ears, better scavenged armor hung with trophies, crude staff or blade.

Hobgoblins are large goblin-like creatures, often over seven feet tall and prefers to wield club-like weapons. Stupid. Often lives with goblins.
Appearance: Hulking goblinoid over seven feet tall, green-gray skin, heavy brutish build, small dull eyes, crude hide coverings, huge wooden club.

Dalan is a short, feminine, male elf adventurer. Amazing with a bow, hates being called cute. Friends with Arryn. Member of the Evergreen Tribe
Appearance: young adult man, short slender elf, messy blonde hair with side braid, pointed ears, green hooded capelet and tunic, white undershirt, brown leather belts, brown gloves, wooden longbow.

Aegis City's Market District is the largest district in the city. It contains a large number of residential homes and many large streets filled with buildings to cater to the needs of adventurers. Many alleyways are set up with stalls for vendors to sell goods.
Appearance: Largest district of Aegis City, wide busy streets of shops, inns and homes, alley vendor stalls, colorful awnings, crowds of adventurers and merchants.

Karos is an exceptional butler who is searching for someone worthy of his service. A hand-to-hand fighter skilled in multiple martial arts.
Appearance: adult man, human, lithe build, short tidy silver hair, light-blue eyes, white dress shirt, black tie, black waistcoat, black tailcoat, black leather gloves, belts on upper arms.

Kazzym is an elder green dragon, ruler of the Forbidden Forest. Known for his short temper and violent nature. Secretly trying to create a philosophers stone. Also secretly publishes alchemy books under a pseudonym. His palace is made of magically twisted trees. Easily pleased if offered rare knowledge.
Appearance: adult man, green elder dragon in humanoid form, muscular, spiky green hair, curved dark horns, green eyes, brown skin, open white robe, dark green cloak with gold trim, gold clasp.

The Forbidden Forest is a dangerous forest filled with all kinds of violent monsters. Ruled by Kazzym. Home to some of the rarest alchemical ingredients in Adolion. Close to a few human settlements the largest of which is Cliffwich.
Appearance: Dense perilous forest, towering ancient trees, thick undergrowth rich in rare alchemical herbs, monster lairs, deep green gloom, Kazzym's palace of twisted trees.
Kazzym's Chosen is a kobold clan that servers Kazzym the Green. Lives in the Forbidden Forest near Kazzym's palace. Led by Greec the Learned.
Greec is a Kobold Shaman that leads Kazzym's Chosen. Earned his position by offering a rare druidic tome to Kazzym.

A Cursed Doll is a creature born when a person transfers a living persons soul into a doll. The doll retains memories and the personality of their old body. Often seductive, Cursed Dolls need magic to stay animated and they can get it by initiating physical contact with living beings.
Appearance: Adult-sized animated doll, porcelain-smooth skin with visible ball joints, glassy eyes, neatly styled hair, frilled gown.

Rhea Allstadt was deemed missing when her family was slaughtered by Inquisitors hundreds of years ago. Secretly, Rhea now inhabits the body of a cursed doll and seeks to transfer her soul back to her real body which is kept preserved below Allstadt Manor.
Appearance: adult woman, cursed porcelain doll, long straight silver hair, black lily hair flowers, pale blue eyes, porcelain skin with doll joints, black frilled gothic lace dress, silver cross brooch.

Allstadt Manor is an abandoned large manor, cobwebs, dusty, cracked windows, expensive furnishings and decorations, large basement used for torture and magical experiments, skeletons in basement, Rhea's preserved young body is kept in the basement in a vat
Appearance: Abandoned large manor, dusty cobwebbed halls, cracked windows, faded costly furnishings, dim gloom, basement laboratory with torture devices and a preserving vat.

The Witch of Thornwood is known in nearby villages as dangerous, people still come to her for help with ailments, her prices are reasonable, rumors say she'll fix any ailment if you give her your soul, rumors say she is actually a demon, rumors are all false.

spike-W1.content: The adventurers' guild hall: a smoky common room, a hearth with the job board beside it, and Ponticius's desk at the back where contracts are signed.
Ponticius is the gruff guild master. He runs the job board, haggles hard over fees and pays rewards out of the guild vault.
A stone sphinx guards the gate of the Sun Ruins. It asks one riddle; the answer is the moon. A wrong answer wakes the sand beneath the gate.
Angular Solari glyphs cover the gates and walls of the Sun Ruins; few living scholars can read them.
Max and Luke's mother keeps a small farm two days north of the city; she disapproves of the guild.

spike-W4.content: A dockside bar on Mercer Street with a back room used for deals; Maeve sings there most nights.
Lieutenant Brandt of the harbor police wears tailored suits and drives a black sedan on a lieutenant's salary.
A rented room above a fishmonger on Pier Street where the department hides witnesses.
Maeve closes every set at the Blue Anchor with 'Harbor Lights'; regulars throw carnations.

scene.objective: Take jobs, climb the ranks and survive Adolion.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The receptionist behind the long counter is an elven woman with green eyes; half the men at the tables are pretending not to stare at her.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I step up to the counter. "I want to sign up. What level does a new member start at, and what kind of jobs can I take on day one?"

scene.objective: Take jobs, climb the ranks and survive Adolion.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: Night in the shanty streets of the capital, where the houses are built from scrap wood and thieves watch every stranger. A thin young man sells canvases from a blanket.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I crouch by the paintings. The faces in them look exactly like the ones on the missing-person notices. "Who signs these? And who buys something this gruesome?"

scene.objective: Take jobs, climb the ranks and survive Adolion.

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: "You want to go south? Into the green hell that swallows a quarter of the continent? The things in there are twisted by whatever leaks out of that place."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "And the gray-skinned warriors with the red eyes? I heard thousands of them live down there under a single chief."

scene.objective: Take jobs, climb the ranks and survive Adolion.

window.speaker: The barbarian
window.text: She rests her huge stone axe on her shoulder. "I was born up there, in the snow peaks where the wall between worlds is thin. My people still wander those passes."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "Your people. The ones who think a woman's place is the cooking fire? No wonder you left."

scene.objective: Take jobs, climb the ranks and survive Adolion.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: Three riders in red cloaks, holy symbols gleaming on their breastplates, block the road. Their leader says they hunt heresy wherever it hides.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "You think the baron isn't the baron anymore? That something from below is wearing his skin? Then how do you drive it out?"

scene.objective: Take jobs, climb the ranks and survive Adolion.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The alchemist unrolls a map and taps a dark mass of trees. "The rarest ingredients grow there. So do the worst monsters in the land."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "I heard a green wyrm rules those woods, with little lizard-folk serving him. Will they let us through if we pay?"

scene.objective: Take jobs, climb the ranks and survive Adolion.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The abandoned mansion is all cobwebs and cracked windows. In a child's bedroom upstairs, a porcelain doll turns its head to follow you.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "The villagers said the family here was butchered by church hunters centuries ago. One daughter was never found."

scene.objective: Get close to the guild's job board to see available missions.

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I weave through the crowded guild hall toward the notice board by the hearth.

window.speaker: DM Narrator
window.text: The board is a mess of pinned parchment: bounties on wolves, a lost cat, and one sheet stamped in gold wax. *Expedition to the Sun Ruins. Guild-sanctioned. Danger: high.*

window.speaker: Arin
window.text: Arin leans over your shoulder. "Gold wax. That's Ponticius's seal. Whatever that is, it pays."

scene.objective: Reach the Sun Ruins with Luke and face the sphinx's riddle.

window.speaker: DM Narrator
window.text: The sphinx's voice rolls across the sand: "I have no light of my own, yet I shine in the dark. I die each month and am born again. What am I?"

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I glance at Arin, then back at the great stone face. "You're the moon."

window.speaker: DM Narrator
window.text: For a long moment the sphinx says nothing. Then the sandstone doors behind it grind open.

scene.objective: Decide whether to take Luke along before departing for the Sun Ruins.

window.speaker: Luke
window.text: "I'm coming with you, right? Right?"

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I kneel so we're eye to eye. "Someone has to look after Mother while I'm gone. That's you. That's the job."

window.speaker: Luke
window.text: His lip trembles, but he nods slowly and steps back from the horses.

scene.objective: Find out who has been paying off the harbor police.

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The back room of the Blue Anchor smells of spilled gin and wet wool.

window.speaker: Lt. Brandt
window.text: "Sit down, detective. Let's talk like reasonable men."

window.speaker: Lt. Brandt
window.text: He sets a fat envelope on the table between you. "Five hundred. For a short memory."

window.speaker: Max
window.text: I glance at the door, then slide the envelope into my inside pocket. "My memory's getting shorter already."

window.speaker: Lt. Brandt
window.text: Brandt smiles for the first time all night. "Smart man."

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: Outside, the rain has turned to sleet. The street lamps hiss.

window.speaker: Mae Hollis
window.text: Mae is waiting by the car, collar up. "Well? What did Brandt want?"

window.speaker: Max
window.text: "To threaten me. I told him where to stick it. I never took a dime from that man, Mae."

window.speaker: Mae Hollis
window.text: She studies my face a moment too long. "Sure. Get in, we're late."

window.speaker: Narrator
window.text: The car pulls away from the curb, wipers beating against the sleet.
